description: This file defines a utility class `ThreadRAII` that manages a std::thread object, ensuring it is properly joined when the `ThreadRAII` object is destroyed. It provides RAII semantics for thread handling, including move semantics.

classes.name: ThreadRAII
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for std::thread that automatically joins the thread upon destruction, with move semantics support.

methods.name: ThreadRAII
methods.description: Constructor that takes an rvalue reference to a std::thread, moving it into the class.

methods.name: ~ThreadRAII
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if it is joinable, with exception handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a reference to the managed thread.
